package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const PracticeTaskContextSchemaV1 = "practice-task-teacher-context.v1"

type PracticeTaskContext struct {
	Schema           string                       `json:"schema"`
	TaskInstanceID   string                       `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID        string                       `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID   string                       `json:"task_revision_id"`
	LearningActionID string                       `json:"learning_action_id"`
	LearningPathID   string                       `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathRef  *PracticeLearningPathRef     `json:"learning_path_reference,omitempty"`
	Surface          string                       `json:"surface_classification"`
	Locale           string                       `json:"locale"`
	Status           string                       `json:"status"`
	Step             PracticeTaskStepContext      `json:"step"`
	AssistancePolicy PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy `json:"assistance_policy"`
	LearningTargets  []LearningTargetRef          `json:"learning_targets"`
	Workspace        PracticeTaskWorkspaceContext `json:"workspace"`
	Validation       PracticeValidationSummary    `json:"validation"`
}

type PracticeLearningPathRef struct {
	ReferenceType string `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID   string `json:"reference_id"`
}

type PracticeTaskStepContext struct {
	ID           string                   `json:"id"`
	Title        string                   `json:"title"`
	Objective    string                   `json:"objective"`
	Deliverables []string                 `json:"deliverables"`
	Acceptance   []PracticeTaskAcceptance `json:"acceptance"`
	Status       string                   `json:"status"`
}

type PracticeTaskAcceptance struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Text         string `json:"text"`
	EvidenceKind string `json:"evidence_kind"`
}

type PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy struct {
	Version                     int                         `json:"version"`
	MaxHintLevel                int                         `json:"max_hint_level"`
	RevealSolutionAfterAttempts *int                        `json:"reveal_solution_after_attempts,omitempty"`
	Teacher                     PracticeTeacherPolicy       `json:"teacher"`
	Debugging                   PracticeTaskDebuggingPolicy `json:"debugging"`
}

type PracticeTeacherPolicy struct {
	MayExplain               bool `json:"may_explain"`
	MayWriteCompleteSolution bool `json:"may_write_complete_solution"`
}

type PracticeTaskDebuggingPolicy struct {
	MayPointToArea     bool `json:"may_point_to_area"`
	MayNameLikelyCause bool `json:"may_name_likely_cause"`
	MaySuggestPatch    bool `json:"may_suggest_patch"`
}

type PracticeTaskWorkspaceContext struct {
	Available        bool              `json:"available"`
	Files            []StudentCodeFile `json:"files"`
	OmittedFileCount int               `json:"omitted_file_count"`
	Truncated        bool              `json:"truncated"`
}

type PracticeValidationSummary struct {
	Available  bool `json:"available"`
	Passed     bool `json:"passed"`
	StageCount int  `json:"stage_count"`
	ErrorCount int  `json:"error_count"`
}

func NormalizePracticeTaskContext(input PracticeTaskContext, studentID, taskInstanceID string) (PracticeTaskContext, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.Surface = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Surface))
	input.Locale = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Locale))
	input.Status = strings.TrimSpace(input.Status)
	input.Step.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.Step.ID)
	input.Step.Title = strings.TrimSpace(input.Step.Title)
	input.Step.Objective = strings.TrimSpace(input.Step.Objective)
	input.Step.Status = strings.TrimSpace(input.Step.Status)
	if input.Schema != PracticeTaskContextSchemaV1 || input.StudentID != strings.TrimSpace(studentID) ||
		input.TaskInstanceID != strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !validUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !validUUID(input.LearningActionID) ||
		(input.Surface != "practice" && input.Surface != "project") || !validValue(input.Locale, 32) ||
		!validPracticeRuntimeStatus(input.Status) || !validValue(input.Step.ID, 128) ||
		!validValue(input.Step.Title, 500) || !validValue(input.Step.Objective, 4000) ||
		!validPracticeStepStatus(input.Step.Status) || len(input.Step.Deliverables) > 100 || len(input.Step.Acceptance) > 100 ||
		input.AssistancePolicy.Version != 1 || input.AssistancePolicy.MaxHintLevel < 0 || input.AssistancePolicy.MaxHintLevel > 7 ||
		input.AssistancePolicy.Teacher.MayWriteCompleteSolution {
		return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	if input.LearningPathID == "" && input.LearningPathRef != nil || input.LearningPathID != "" && input.LearningPathRef == nil {
		return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	if input.LearningPathRef != nil {
		input.LearningPathRef.ReferenceType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathRef.ReferenceType))
		input.LearningPathRef.ReferenceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathRef.ReferenceID)
		if !validUUID(input.LearningPathID) || input.LearningPathRef.ReferenceType != "practice" || !validUUID(input.LearningPathRef.ReferenceID) {
			return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
	}
	if input.AssistancePolicy.RevealSolutionAfterAttempts != nil && *input.AssistancePolicy.RevealSolutionAfterAttempts < 1 {
		return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	for index := range input.Step.Deliverables {
		input.Step.Deliverables[index] = strings.TrimSpace(input.Step.Deliverables[index])
		if !validValue(input.Step.Deliverables[index], 1000) {
			return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
	}
	for index := range input.Step.Acceptance {
		item := &input.Step.Acceptance[index]
		item.ID, item.Text, item.EvidenceKind = strings.TrimSpace(item.ID), strings.TrimSpace(item.Text), strings.TrimSpace(item.EvidenceKind)
		if !validValue(item.ID, 128) || !validValue(item.Text, 2000) || !validValue(item.EvidenceKind, 64) {
			return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
	}
	targets, err := normalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.LearningTargets, 100)
	if err != nil {
		return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	for _, target := range targets {
		if target.Version == "" {
			return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
	}
	input.LearningTargets = targets
	if err := normalizePracticeWorkspace(&input.Workspace); err != nil || !validPracticeValidation(input.Validation) {
		return PracticeTaskContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizePracticeWorkspace(workspace *PracticeTaskWorkspaceContext) error {
	if len(workspace.Files) > 12 || workspace.OmittedFileCount < 0 || workspace.OmittedFileCount > 100000 ||
		(!workspace.Available && (len(workspace.Files) > 0 || workspace.OmittedFileCount != 0 || workspace.Truncated)) {
		return errors.New("invalid practice workspace")
	}
	seen, total := map[string]struct{}{}, 0
	for index := range workspace.Files {
		file := &workspace.Files[index]
		file.Path = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(file.Path, "\\", "/"))
		if file.Path == "" || strings.HasPrefix(file.Path, "/") || strings.Contains("/"+file.Path+"/", "/../") ||
			strings.ContainsRune(file.Path, '\x00') || !utf8.ValidString(file.Content) || len(file.Content) > 16<<10 {
			return errors.New("invalid practice workspace file")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[file.Path]; duplicate {
			return errors.New("duplicate practice workspace file")
		}
		seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
		total += len(file.Content)
	}
	if total > 64<<10 || workspace.Truncated != (workspace.OmittedFileCount > 0) {
		return errors.New("invalid practice workspace bounds")
	}
	return nil
}

func validPracticeValidation(input PracticeValidationSummary) bool {
	if input.StageCount < 0 || input.StageCount > 1000 || input.ErrorCount < 0 || input.ErrorCount > 10000 {
		return false
	}
	return input.Available || (!input.Passed && input.StageCount == 0 && input.ErrorCount == 0)
}

func validPracticeRuntimeStatus(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "ACTIVE", "IN_REVIEW", "CHANGES_REQUESTED", "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED", "COMPLETED":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validPracticeStepStatus(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "LOCKED", "LEARNING_REQUIRED", "AVAILABLE", "CHECKPOINTED", "PASSED":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func NewPracticeStudentContext(practice PracticeTaskContext, learningActionID string, contextType LearningContextType, mastery []StudentTargetMastery) (StudentContext, error) {
	practice, err := NormalizePracticeTaskContext(practice, practice.StudentID, practice.TaskInstanceID)
	if err != nil || !validUUID(strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID)) || practice.LearningActionID != strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID) ||
		(contextType != LearningContextPracticeTask && contextType != LearningContextProject) ||
		(contextType == LearningContextPracticeTask && practice.Surface != "practice") ||
		(contextType == LearningContextProject && practice.Surface != "project") ||
		len(mastery) != len(practice.LearningTargets) {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	for index, item := range mastery {
		targets, targetErr := normalizeLearningTargetRefs([]LearningTargetRef{item.Target}, 1)
		if targetErr != nil || targetIdentity(targets[0]) != targetIdentity(practice.LearningTargets[index]) || !validTargetMastery(item) {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		mastery[index].Target = targets[0]
	}
	return StudentContext{
		StudentID: practice.StudentID, LearningActionID: strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID),
		TaskID: practice.TaskRevisionID, ContextType: contextType, ContextID: practice.TaskInstanceID,
		LearningTargets: append([]LearningTargetRef(nil), practice.LearningTargets...),
		RelevantMastery: append([]StudentTargetMastery(nil), mastery...), PracticeTask: &practice,
	}, nil
}
